title: Lost Mary BM600 Grape Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Grape delivers a juicy burst of classic Grape flavour, rich with lush dark fruit character and just a hint of tang. Smooth and sweet without being overpowering, this is a clean, rounded flavour that will appeal to anyone who enjoys familiar, fruity profiles with plenty of depth. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit. The nic salt formulation provides a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw with fast-acting nicotine satisfaction. Each twin pack contains two pods, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on vaping style. Once a pod is depleted, simply replace it with a fresh one to continue enjoying uninterrupted flavour.
